fullPassage: Every four years, a twenty-ninth day is added to the month of February. This day, also known as Leap Day, was created to ensure that our calendar and our seasons stay in line with each other. While we think that a normal year consists of 365 days, it actually takes Earth about 365.2421 days to orbit the sun. Every four years, it is necessary to add an extra day to account for the lost time. Without the addition of a leap day, winter would occur earlier in the calendar year, causing problems for agricultural schedules and potentially leading to crop failures. Additionally, many holidays and cultural celebrations are linked to specific seasons or dates. Without leap years to keep the calendar in check, these events would gradually drift away from their intended time of celebration.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① knowing → known이 정답. 'known as'는 '~로 알려진'이라는 뜻으로 앞의 This day를 꾸미는 과거분사예요. 밑줄은 knowing(현재분사, 능동 '아는')으로 잘못 제시됐어요.
det.analysis:
① knowing: This day, also ___ as Leap Day(이 날은 Leap Day로 알려진) — 날이 '알려지는' 것이니 수동, 과거분사 known이 맞아요. knowing(현재분사, 능동 '아는')은 틀려요 → known. ←정답

② created: was created(만들어졌다) — be동사+과거분사 수동태로 적절해요.

③ occur: winter would occur(겨울이 올 것이다) — 조동사 would 뒤에 동사원형 occur, 적절해요.

④ drift: these events would drift(이 행사들이 벗어날 것이다) — would 뒤 동사원형 drift, 적절해요.
det.tip: also known as = ~로 알려진(과거분사). 사물이 '알려지는' 것은 수동이에요.

④ keep: leap years to keep the calendar(달력을 유지하기 위한 윤년) — to부정사 뒤 동사원형 keep, 적절해요.

questions.passage: Every four years, a twenty-ninth day is added to the month of February. This day, also known as Leap Day, was created to ensure that our calendar and our seasons <u>stay in line with</u> each other. While we think that a normal year consists of 365 days, it actually takes Earth about 365.2421 days to orbit the sun. Every four years, it is necessary to add an extra day to account for the lost time. Without the addition of a leap day, winter would occur earlier in the calendar year, causing problems for agricultural schedules and potentially leading to crop failures. Additionally, many holidays and cultural celebrations are linked to specific seasons or dates. Without leap years to keep the calendar in check, these events would gradually drift away from their intended time of celebration.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 stay in line with의 함축 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: stay in line with = 서로 어긋나지 않고 나란히/일치된 상태를 유지하다. 달력과 계절이 서로 맞아떨어진다는 뜻이에요.
det.analysis:
① 서로 완전히 분리되어 제각기 움직이다: 오히려 반대 의미예요.

② 서로 어긋나지 않고 일치된 상태를 유지하다: 'stay in line with(발맞추다)'의 정확한 뜻이에요. ←정답

③ 한 줄로 나란히 서서 순서를 기다리다: line을 '줄서기'로 오해한 함정이에요.

④ 번갈아 가며 서로 자리를 바꾸다: 그런 의미는 없어요.
det.tip: stay/be in line with ~ = ~와 보조를 맞추다, 일치하다.

det.korean: these events(이 행사들)는 바로 앞 문장의 'many holidays and cultural celebrations(많은 명절과 문화 행사)'를 가리켜요.
det.analysis:

③ 명절과 문화적 기념 행사: 앞 문장 'holidays and cultural celebrations'를 그대로 받은 말이에요. ←정답

det.tip: these events → 앞에서 말한 holidays and cultural celebrations를 묶어 부른 말이에요.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸을 완성하시오. (7단어) (영어로)
'윤일을 더하는 것 없이는'
[조건] (1) a, addition, day, leap, of, the, without을 모두 사용
(2) 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: '윤일을 더하는 것 없이는' = Without the addition of a leap day. without(~없이) + the addition of(~을 더하는 것) + a leap day(윤일).
det.analysis:
핵심은 '~을 더하는 것'을 명사구 the addition of로 쓰는 거예요.

without(전치사, ~없이) 뒤에는 명사가 와야 해서 add(동사)가 아니라 the addition(명사)을 써요. the addition of a leap day = 윤일을 더하는 것. 순서대로 without → the addition → of → a leap day = 7단어예요.
det.tip: without + 명사. '더하기'는 동사 add가 아니라 명사 addition으로!
